recipe_version.title: Lentil-Stuffed Cabbage with Tomato Sauce
recipe_version.description: Cabbage leaves rolled around brown lentils and parcooked rice, baked in a tomato sauce made from crushed tomatoes.

ingredients.name: green cabbage
ingredients.note: 1 large head, about 3 lb; 8 large outer leaves for rolls; chop the leftover inner head into the sauce

ingredients.name: brown lentils
ingredients.note: dry brown lentils, not canned and not red lentils

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice
ingredients.note: dry; parcooked, then finished in the oven

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.note: divided: 1 diced for the filling, 1 diced for the sauce

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: divided: 2 cloves in the filling, 2 cloves in the sauce

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: 1 tbsp for the filling onion, 2 tbsp for the sauce

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: 1.5 tsp in the filling, 1 tsp in the sauce, 1 tsp in the blanch water (drained, not eaten)

ingredients.name: sweet paprika
ingredients.note: single spice, not a spice blend

ingredients.name: crushed tomatoes
ingredients.note: one can, store-bought crushed tomatoes, not a prepared pasta sauce

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: divided: 4 cups to simmer the lentils, of which 1/2 cup is reserved into the sauce and the rest drained; 2 cups to parcook the rice, then drained and discarded

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.note: divided: 2 tbsp in the filling, 1 tbsp on top at the end

steps.title: Blanch the cabbage
steps.body: Bring a large pot of tap water to a boil with 1 tsp of the kosher salt. This blanch pot is not the measured water ingredient; that measured water is only for the lentils and the rice. The teaspoon of kosher salt is drained away and is not eaten. Do not drop it below 1 tsp when scaling. Core the green cabbage, lower the head in, and boil about 8 minutes, until 8 large outer leaves peel off without tearing. Rinse the leaves in cold water, pat them dry, and shave the thick part of each rib flat. Chop the leftover inner head. You need 8 leaves, not 12.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.body: Rinse the brown lentils. Simmer them in 4 cups of the water for 18 minutes, until tender with a bite in the center. If they are mush now, the rolls split later. Drain, and reserve 1/2 cup of that cooking water for the sauce. Discard the rest of the lentil water.

steps.title: Parcook the rice
steps.body: In a separate pot, simmer the long-grain white rice in the remaining 2 cups of water for 8 minutes. It should be half-cooked, with a white core. Drain and discard that water. The rice finishes in the oven.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.body: Heat a skillet over medium. Add 1 tbsp of the olive oil and 1 diced yellow onion. Cook 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of the garlic, the sweet paprika, 1.5 tsp of the kosher salt, and the black pepper. Stir 1 minute. Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the brown lentils, the long-grain white rice, and 2 tbsp of the fresh parsley. The filling should be moist, not soupy. If it is wet enough to pour, the rolls will burst.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: In a saucepan over medium, heat the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil. Add the second diced yellow onion and cook 6 minutes. Add the remaining 2 cloves of garlic, the crushed tomatoes, the reserved 1/2 cup lentil water, the red wine vinegar, the brown sugar, the remaining 1 tsp kosher salt, and the chopped inner green cabbage. Simmer 10 minutes. The sauce should pour. If it is a paste, do not add new water; you have lost the reserved lentil water and this batch is off the recipe.

steps.title: Roll
steps.body: Heat the oven to 375 F now so it reaches temperature while you roll. Lay one green cabbage leaf flat. Spoon about 1/2 cup of filling on the rib end. Fold the sides in and roll it closed. Repeat for all 8 leaves. Pack them seam side down in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over them, including the crushed tomatoes. Cover. The oven preheat overlaps this rolling; do not add a separate cold-start wait after the tray is packed.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: When the oven is at 375 F, bake 40 minutes covered, then 10 minutes uncovered, until a green cabbage leaf edge shows browned spots and the center of a roll is hot and steaming. The published cook clock stays sequential for stove and bake heat only: blanch 8 + lentils 18 + rice 8 + filling about 6 + sauce about 16 + bake 50 = about 106 minutes. Oven preheat is started in the roll step and is not a second cold start here. No sour cream, no cheese, and no bread.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve two rolls per person with sauce. Sprinkle the remaining 1 tbsp fresh parsley. Do not add a dairy finish.

equipment: baking dish with a lid or foil
recipe_version.heat: Stove for the lentils, rice, filling, and sauce. Oven 375 F for the covered bake, then uncovered.
recipe_version.doneness: Lentils are simmered only until tender with a bite, then finish in the oven. Rolls bake 40 minutes covered and 10 minutes uncovered at 375 F until the center filling is hot and steaming and the leaf edges show browned spots.

scaling_notes.1: Two large leaves, not a fraction of a leaf. Buy a small head; the unused leaves are not a second recipe. Filling: 1/4 cup dry brown lentils and 2 tbsp dry long-grain white rice. Sauce floor: 3/4 cup crushed tomatoes, not a strict quarter of the 28 oz can, or the dish bakes dry. Use 1 small yellow onion, half diced in the filling and half in the sauce. One garlic clove in the filling and one in the sauce. Blanch salt stays 1 tsp even for two leaves. Oven stays 375 F. Bake time stays about 40 minutes covered and 10 uncovered. Two rolls do not finish in 15 minutes.
scaling_notes.2: Four leaves. Half the lentils (1/2 cup) and rice (1/4 cup). Use half the can of crushed tomatoes, 14 oz, in a smaller dish, not a quarter can. One yellow onion split between filling and sauce. Halve the oil, paprika, pepper, parsley, vinegar, and sugar. Food salt halves; blanch salt stays 1 tsp. Same oven and the same lentil texture rule.
scaling_notes.4: As written. Eight leaves, two rolls per person, one 28 oz can, 1 cup dry lentils, 1/2 cup dry rice.
do_not_scale: the rule to stop the lentils while they still have a bite

coverage_contribution: Stuffed bake is a format the live 24 and the three DR1 drafts do not have. It is not a bowl, taco, curry, or the existing lentil stew. The tomato sauce is cooked from store-bought crushed tomatoes. Counted leaves, a sauce floor, a can that does not quarter, and blanch salt that does not scale are the shopping stress. HH001 plant meal with an empty allergen array.
near_duplicate_review: Smoky Lentil Sweet Potato Stew is the lentil meal in the 24: a stew, no cabbage rolls, no rice, no baked sauce. White Bean Kale Soup is beans, not stuffed leaves. This is not a rename of Herbed Polenta with Tomato Stew. No cheese, so it is not a gratin.
